df-001: Login request with email and password (HTTP) df-001 authentication: Email and password checked against the Users table in login handler; evidence: routes/login.ts:34
df-002: User registration POST /api/Users (HTTP) df-002 authentication: Registration route has no authentication handler; evidence: frontend/src/app/Services/user.service.ts:38
df-003: Server-side fetch of requester-supplied image URL (HTTP)
df-004: WebSocket RPC event subscriptions for NFT mint and wallet exploit contracts (WebSocket)
df-005: Chatbot prompts and tool context sent to configured model endpoint (HTTP)

df-006: Sequelize queries against embedded SQLite database (SQLite) df-006 authentication: Embedded SQLite engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: models/index.ts:34

df-007: Reviews and orders in embedded marsdb collections (marsdb) df-007 authentication: Embedded MarsDB engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: data/mongodb.ts:9, data/mongodb.ts:10
df-008: socket.io events pushed to connected browsers (WebSocket)

df-009: OAuth authorization (HTTPS) df-009 authentication: The identity provider authenticates the user at its sign-in endpoint; evidence: frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:31, frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148
df-010: OAuth profile request (HTTPS) df-010 authentication: The provider checks the OAuth access token sent with the request; evidence: frontend/src/app/Services/user.service.ts:68

df-011: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-011 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/checkKeys.ts:34, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186

df-012: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-013: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-014: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-012 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:52, routes/dataExport.ts:18, routes/orderHistory.ts:13, lib/insecurity.ts:156 df-012 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-013 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/recycles.ts:23, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186 df-013 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-014 authentication: token decoded without signature verification; evidence: routes/chat.ts:223 df-014 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-016: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-017: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-016 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-016 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-017 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/login.ts:18, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186 df-017 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-019: Direct requests (cookie) (HTTP) df-019 authentication: the handler checks a cookie credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: routes/profileImageFileUpload.ts:35, routes/profileImageUrlUpload.ts:21, routes/userProfile.ts:34, routes/updateUserProfile.ts:17, routes/dataErasure.ts:26, routes/dataErasure.ts:76

g.text: data flow · classification colour · two heads = bidirectional
trust boundary crossed between these columns
trust change within a column (dashed: inferred)
dashed outline = zone, not itself a boundary
solid = direct attack · dashed = via user
STRIDE category: filled = findings in that category
All Critical · High fills to 5 · +N = omitted High categories
counts on a node = threats per severity · ①–⑨ = attack scenario
badges also count scenarios that hit an asset stored there
Dynamic code evaluation = runs runtime data as program code
Most security-critical functions always shown (at most 5), others up
to 3 labels per element: most critical first, then most severe linked
finding; +N = further labels, listed under Further capabilities.
Functions may go undetected: a missing label does not mean absence.
Stored username evaluated as server code
The recipient performs no authentication check on this connection.
The recipient checks the supplied password.
The recipient checks the token supplied with the request.
A session cookie identifies the caller.
Delegated access; only the evidenced protocol step is covered.
Authentication could not be determined from the code.
Numbered hexagon: authentication · circle: attack scenario
Red: absent / unsafe · yellow: standard / limited · green: stronger
Method properties, not proof of a secure implementation.
